summary: Backend fully verified for CheerPlanner TeamChat extras (pin items + AI quick-add). 14/14 pytest cases pass against the live preview. Code review of chat_extras.py, ChatPinnedItems.tsx, ChatQuickAdd.tsx, and team/chat.tsx integration confirms correct wiring (testIDs match spec, Add-to… row placed ABOVE pin/report/block in actions modal, pins mounted above KeyboardAvoidingView). Frontend UI could not be exercised interactively — Playwright login flow repeatedly failed to establish a session on the Expo web preview (login submit did not fire, and injecting the token directly into localStorage / @AsyncStorage:ct_auth_token also did not authenticate the SPA). This is a known Playwright/Expo-web limitation that has blocked UI runs across several recent iterations; recommend main agent self-verify the mobile UI (or run via real Expo Go).

integration_issues.issue: Unable to establish an authenticated session via Playwright (login submit no-op; direct localStorage token injection does not hydrate AuthContext). Blocks automated UI verification but is NOT a product bug — curl + fetch against /api work. Main agent should self-test the UI on device or Expo Go.

action_items: Main agent to self-verify the mobile UI flows (pin strip visibility, pin picker → event → option, custom-detail modal, long-press → Add to… order, quickadd AI prefill + save) via Expo Go or physical device, as Playwright web-preview auth is unreliable here.
No code changes required for backend — all pin + quick-add endpoints pass.
critical_code_review_comments: chat_extras.py line 83: can_open correctly set False for custom pins and non-household owners.
chat_extras.py line 142: pin creation reads owner_id from the source doc — safe because snapshot already validated membership via owners list.
chat_extras.py line 198: non-hub (/404) path uses team_messages collection scoped to the household — matches spec.
team/chat.tsx line 679: chat-action-quickadd is rendered BEFORE pin/report/block/delete rows (as required).
ChatQuickAdd save paths all use existing /api/schedule, /api/expenses, /api/fundraisers, /api/competitions endpoints — no new endpoints invoked incorrectly.
seed_data_creation: Transient test pins (TEST_pin_custom / TEST_del_perm / TEST_parent) are created and deleted inside tests; no persistent seed changes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_chat_extras.py covers: list pins (staff/parent), pin-options (staff ok, parent 403, bad kind 400), create+delete custom, create competition + duplicate 409, parent cannot create/delete, quick-add 404 on bad id, quick-add rich packing/watch/expense message, parent-can-use quick-add. Run with EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL set.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found. Playwright blockage traced to Expo web auth guard not hydrating from manually seeded localStorage; applies to multiple iterations and is a tooling limitation, not a product defect.
